lines.speaker: vo
lines.text: A number floats over everyone's head. How many times they've helped someone.

lines.speaker: vo
lines.text: Gold numbers got the velvet rope.

lines.speaker: vo
lines.text: And the helpers? They only helped when someone was watching.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: A zero can't be trusted, buddy. It's literally over your head.

lines.speaker: vo
lines.text: So everyone figured zero meant I'd never helped anyone.

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: I like your number. It's red.

lines.speaker: vo
lines.text: Only one person ever sat with me.

lines.speaker: vo
lines.text: Late at night, when nobody was around…

lines.speaker: vo
lines.text: Nobody saw. The number never moved.

lines.speaker: vo
lines.text: One of them looked right at him.

lines.speaker: vo
lines.text: Thousands of helpers. They ran right past.

lines.speaker: guest
lines.text: Your number… it's not going up.

lines.speaker: vo
lines.text: Nobody was watching. My number still said zero.

lines.speaker: vo
lines.text: Turns out, the meter never counted help. It counted audiences.

lines.speaker: vo
lines.text: Zero didn't mean I never helped.

lines.speaker: vo
lines.text: It meant I never did it for clout.

lines.speaker: vo
lines.text: Help when nobody's watching. That's the only kind that counts.
